items.title: Visa (V) Ties Monad Stablecoin Settlement Move To New Fraud API Rollout
items.summary: Visa (NYSE: V) has added the Monad blockchain to its stablecoin settlement program as a new multi-chain option. Global Payments is integrating Visa's IDX API into its Adaptive Authentication service to support identity and fraud checks for clients. Both moves signal Visa's push to expand blockchain-based settlement tools and strengthen digital transaction security for payment partners.
